degree_rationale: The Three Garments (wind, fire, water) by which Living Spirit clothed himself when ordering cosmos — and stripped, washed, established the works. Garments are the outermost manifestation/ultimation of essential power.
direction_rationale: Garmenting is the western quality par excellence — the love-essence putting on its outermost clothing for the work, then setting the works in place.
grand_man_function: Celestial garmenting — love clothed for cosmic work.
title: The Three Garments worn by the Living Spirit at the cosmos's making
